#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Task {
    const long long mod = 1000000007;

    long long getDp0(const std::vector<std::vector<long long>>& dp, int i, int j) {
        if (i >= (int)dp.size() || j >= (int)dp[0].size()) return 0;
        return dp[i][j];
    }

    long long getDp1(const std::vector<std::vector<long long>>& dp, int i, int j) {
        if (i >= (int)dp.size() || j >= (int)dp[0].size()) return 0;
        return dp[i][j];
    }

    void solve() {
        ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
        cin.tie(nullptr);
        int n;
        cin >> n;
        std::vector<std::vector<long long>> dp0(n + 1, std::vector<long long>(n + 1, 0));
        std::vector<std::vector<long long>> dp1(n + 1, std::vector<long long>(n + 1, 0));

        for (int total = 0; total <= 2 * n; total++) {
            for (int i = std::min(n, total); i >= 0; i--) {
                int j = total - i;
                if (j > n || j < 0 || i < 0 || j > i || (i == n && j == n))
                    continue;

                if (i == j) {
                    long long val1 = 1 + getDp1(dp1, i + 1, j);
                    long long val2 = getDp0(dp0, i + 1, j);
                    dp0[i][j] = std::max(val1, val2);
                } else if (i == n) {
                    long long val1 = 1 + getDp1(dp1, i, j + 1);
                    long long val2 = getDp0(dp0, i, j + 1);
                    dp0[i][j] = std::max(val1, val2);
                } else {
                    long long v1 = (getDp0(dp0, i + 1, j) + getDp0(dp0, i, j + 1)) % mod;
                    long long v2 = (1 + getDp1(dp1, i + 1, j) + getDp0(dp0, i, j + 1)) % mod;
                    long long v3 = (1 + getDp0(dp0, i + 1, j) + getDp1(dp1, i, j + 1)) % mod;
                    dp0[i][j] = std::max(v1, std::max(v2, v3));
                }

                if (i == j) {
                    dp1[i][j] = getDp0(dp0, i + 1, j);
                } else if (i == n) {
                    dp1[i][j] = getDp0(dp0, i, j + 1);
                } else {
                    long long v1 = (getDp0(dp0, i + 1, j) + getDp0(dp0, i, j + 1)) % mod;
                    dp1[i][j] = v1;
                }
            }
        }
        cout << dp0[0][0] % mod << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    Task task;
    task.solve();
    return 0;
}
